_comment: student102 API token config. Fill in the tokens you have, leave the others empty.
_puter_auth_token_help: Steps: log in → open Dev Tools (F12) → Application tab → Local Storage → puter.com → find key 'puter_auth_token'
_puter_login_help: Optional fallback if PUTER_AUTH_TOKEN is missing.
The installer will auto-login and retrieve a token.
_google_api_key_help: Optional. Needed ONLY if you want Google Gemini image generation (requires billing).
Get it from https://aistudio.google.com → Get API Key
Note: PUTER_AUTH_TOKEN is free and preferred. Only set this if Puter is unavailable.
_gemini_api_key_help: Alias for GOOGLE_API_KEY. Set either one — not both needed.
